paper_role: post-review supplemental core-mechanism ablation on the frozen CTP100 multi-turn scope

research_questions.question: Does the structured cross-turn goal-state representation contribute to multi-turn task success when previous business results are not reused?
Does dependency-aware downstream invalidation propagation contribute to multi-turn consistency and task success?

adaptive_multi_agent_no_reuse.role: existing matched reference for the state ablation
adaptive_multi_agent_no_reuse.result_stripping_policy: Previous slots are retained; previous agent outputs, tool results, attractions, weather, itinerary, and budget artifacts are stripped.

adaptive_multi_agent_no_state.dynamic_agent_and_tool_scheduling: retained only as stateless current-request capability routing; it must not consume a goal-state ticket
allowed_inputs: the method's own ordinary role/content dialogue history
ephemeral understanding parsed from visible text in the current turn
adaptive_multi_agent_no_state.interpretation: This removes explicit persisted cross-turn goal state. Natural-language dialogue remains visible because removing the dialogue itself would test memory deprivation rather than structured state representation.

retained_behavior: direct invalidation caused by the changed slot
reuse-validity checks for each previous result
upstream dependency completion when a required upstream result is missing
the full M3 agent order, tool order, prompts, model, and frozen data
removed_behavior: adding a reusable downstream result solely because an upstream result is re-executed
invalidating a downstream result solely because an upstream previous result is unusable
adaptive_multi_agent_no_propagation.interpretation: Potentially stale downstream reuse is intentional in this variant; it is the mechanism being tested, not an implementation error.

invalidation_decomposition.purpose: Separate direct slot impact from transitive downstream propagation without changing M3-full's final scheduling decisions when propagation is enabled.
invalidation_decomposition.full_m3_equivalence_requirement: With propagation enabled, final planned, reused, and invalidated agent sets must match the pre-refactor M3-full decisions for the frozen regression cases.
invalidation_decomposition.no_propagation_rule: With propagation disabled, apply only direct seeds and required upstream completion; do not add dependent agents solely through propagation.

state_ablation_primary.single_intended_difference: availability of explicit structured cross-turn goal state
state_ablation_primary.why_not_full_m3_as_primary: M3-full also reuses previous business results, so a direct primary comparison would confound structured state with result reuse.

cross_ablation_policy.reason: The two variants remove different mechanisms and are not a one-factor matched pair.

selection_policy.selected_unit: all source cases whose turns field is a list of exactly two turns

propagation_activation_design_candidates.basis: Frozen annotated changed-slot categories combined with the frozen direct-seed and propagation-edge policy.
propagation_activation_design_candidates.runtime_requirement: The implementation must independently audit actual propagation opportunities; these design candidates must never be injected into generation or used to select successful rows.

run_scope.execution_policy: Each method must generate its own t1 result and t2 may consume only information permitted by that same method's contract.
run_scope.first_turn_role: setup turn required to construct method-local history; report separately and do not pool it into the primary mechanism-effect endpoint

adaptive_multi_agent.filter: method == adaptive_multi_agent AND scenario_id in selected_case_ids

existing_reference_results.rerun_policy: Do not rerun or replace existing references merely to improve their scores. A missing or hash-mismatched reference artifact blocks the corresponding comparison.

same_as_reference: failure classification and failure retention policy
forbidden_during_ablation_implementation: editing the CTP100 or CTP30 datasets
editing gold labels or evaluator rules
editing business-agent prompts to favor an ablation
changing the LLM model or sampling parameters
changing QWeather, budget, POI, accommodation, restaurant, or intercity data
selecting cases from observed model success or failure
silently falling back to mock outputs
selectively rerunning failed rows to replace them

outcomes_and_reporting.primary_scope: t2 only across all 30 frozen scenarios and all three repeats
outcomes_and_reporting.failure_policy: Method failures and terminal API infrastructure failures remain in the denominator and are reported separately; integrity failures block paper claims.
outcomes_and_reporting.claim_boundary: These ablations support mechanism claims only on the frozen CTP100 two-turn controlled benchmark; they do not establish generalization to arbitrary tourism conversations.

before_any_llm_run: the JSON and Markdown contracts agree
the source dataset hash and all selected case IDs match
both existing comparator result hashes match
M3-no-state has no structured cross-turn state or result-reuse path
M3-no-propagation records the required propagation audit fields
the deterministic dry-run audit finds at least one real propagation opportunity
the worktree is clean and the implementation commit is tagged
hard_block_if: selected scenario count is not 30 or selected turn count is not 60
a comparator artifact is missing or its hash differs
the default M3-full regression decision changes
gold or evaluator-only data becomes visible to generation
after_run: each new method has 180 rows and repeat indices 0, 1, and 2
each t2 consumes only its own method's t1 history under the method contract
traces, worker I/O, checkpoints, manifest, gate report, and final artifact index are complete

change_control.before_results: A necessary protocol correction requires a new versioned contract and an explicit reason before any model call.
change_control.after_results: Do not alter method definitions, selected cases, endpoints, or comparator sources after inspecting ablation outcomes. Any later exploratory variant must receive a new name and be reported as exploratory.
change_control.paper_disclosure: State that the core-ablation protocol was frozen before implementation results and that existing M3-full and M3-no-reuse references were identified by immutable hashes.
